## Features

AVENIQ mobile app development packages incorporate comprehensive cross-platform mobile capabilities:

- **Cross-Platform React Native Architecture**: Single type-safe TypeScript codebase compiling to native iOS and Android user interface components.
- **Native Device Feature Integration**: Deep integration with hardware capabilities—including camera capture, GPS geolocation, biometrics (Face ID/Touch ID), and accelerometer.
- **Push Notification Engine**: Integrated push notification capabilities using Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) and Apple Push Notification service (APNs).
- **Secure Authentication & Biometric Login**: Seamless user login supporting social authentication, magic links, Face ID, Touch ID, and biometrics.
- **Digital Wallet & Payment Processing**: Instant in-app payment processing via Stripe, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and localized payment gateways.
- **Offline Mode & Data Sync**: Local data caching ensuring app functionality continues offline, automatically syncing changes when network connection resumes.
- **Real-Time Data Webhooks**: WebSockets and real-time database subscriptions providing instant order updates, chat messaging, and live status changes.
